description: FEATURE-ORDERED REASSEMBLY (synthesis half): cuts the MONO source wav at the segment times listed in an fturanal anal featurefile and splices the segments back in order of the measured features - mode 1 = ascending 1st formant (modes 2-7 and 9-10: descending F1, F2 up/down, F3 up/down, brightness up, formant-sum up/down; the banner's mode list omits 8 but mode 8 is ACCEPTED and runs - presumably descending brightness). Duration approximately static: splice overlaps shave a little (2.0 s source, 5 segments, default 5 ms splices -> 1.9800 s, -1.0%). Deterministic; output verified audible (-11.3 dBFS). Featurefile times at or beyond the wav's end are ignored with 'WARNING: Times at or beyond end of sndfile (...) ... Ignoring them.' (verified - the .ana-derived duration row exceeds the wav length by one analysis window, so this warning is NORMAL on every straight anal->synth chain).
musical_use: A remix whose sorting key is timbre: the phrase's own events are re-strung from dark to bright (or by vowel colour, choosing a formant mode) instead of in time order - speech becomes a vowel-sorted incantation, a drum phrase becomes a rising sizzle, a melodic phrase reorders into a spectral crescendo. The featurefile is plain text and the synth only trusts its TIMES row for cutting (features determine order), so you can also hand-edit the feature rows to force an arbitrary segment order - a general cut-and-resequence engine driven by a text file. Splicelen trades click-safety against transient sharpness (2-15 ms). Pair: analyse once with fturanal anal, then render several synth modes from the same featurefile for a family of orderings of the same material.

featurefile.description: REQUIRED feature datafile from fturanal anal run on THIS wav's analysis (5 rows: times+duration, F1, F2, F3, brightness). Times beyond the wav's end are ignored with a WARNING (normal for .ana-derived times). Reference its session path.

splicelen.description: Splice length for cutting segments (CDP-enforced 2-15 ms, refusal '-s20' verbatim '(2.000000 to 15.000000)'; banner default 5).

examples.description: Re-string a phrase by rising first formant.
examples.expected_use: Segments splice back in ascending-F1 order; duration ~= source minus splice losses.

known_issues: Duration is static within ~1% (splice overlaps shave a few ms per join: 5 segments/5 ms -> -1.0% on 2 s); more segments or longer splices shave more - the model is 'static' with that safe drift.

BANNER GAP: the mode list documents 1-7 and 9-10 but skips 8; the usage line says '1-10' and mode 8 IS accepted and runs (presumably descending brightness). Mode 11 refused 'Program mode value [11] is out of range [1 - 10].'
'WARNING: Times at or beyond end of sndfile ... Ignoring them.' appears on normal chains (analysis-derived times overshoot the wav by one window) - not an error.
MONO source only (banner: 'reassemble MONO source file').
The featurefile must describe THIS sound's timeline - foreign feature files cut at meaningless times (garbage-in reordering, no refusal).
Deterministic (byte-identical decoded samples run to run).
